description: Elections Commission - A. G. Peramunage of the Kurunegala Municipal Council has vacated member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - W. P. Sarachchandra of the Bingiriya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - D. N. D. Dilhami of the Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of the member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, declaring that specific members of local government councils (Kurunegala Municipal Council, Bingiriya Pradeshiya Sabha, Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local authorities, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
